commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Surely that's handball by one of the Osasuna players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
88' The game is interrupted now, Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
81' Today's match ends for Unai Garcia who will be replaced by Alejandro Catena (Osasuna).
80' Unai Garcia (Osasuna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
78' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
74' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Jon Moncayola is replaced by Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
73' That's the end of the game for Ante Budimir, who is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
73' Substitution. Juan Cruz (Osasuna) replaces Johan Mojica.
72' The corner from Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is intercepted by the defence.
72' Here is a change. Benat Turrientes is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad).
72' It's time for a substitution. Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) comes on in place of Jon Aramburu.
71' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) prepares to take a corner kick.

71' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Real Sociedad force a corner. They send men into the box.
67' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
67' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
65' Substitution. Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) has come on for Ruben Pena.
64' The Osasuna players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
62' Substitution. Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mikel Merino walks off.
62' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Arsen Zakharyan will be replaced by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
62' Substitution. Andre Silva will be replaced by Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad).
61' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
54' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
52' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

51' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.

50' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header down inside the right post. 0:1.
49' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is about to take a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) tries to find Ante Budimir, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
45+3' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging some short passes.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
41' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

38' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.

38' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Sergio Herrera pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom right corner. The referee blows his whistle, Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
38' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
34' PENALTY APPEAL after Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
32' Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
29' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
25' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
25' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
21' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
16' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul. Osasuna have a free kick.
14' 68:32 – the latest ball possession ratio.

10' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.

8' A pass from Javi Galan gives Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) a shooting opportunity on the edge of the box, but the effort is poor and goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
8' Real Sociedad control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
5' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
3' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Javi Galan (Real Sociedad). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.

Osasuna will kick the game off.
